Subject: MAP kickoff — SaaSCo POC: cadence, success criteria, weekly checkpoints

Hi Rebecca / Tom —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, we want to get a short, actionable mutual action plan (MAP) standing so everyone is aligned on the POC scope, acceptance criteria, and a weekly cadence to unblock engineering and procurement.

High-level proposal:
- Weekly 30-minute checkpoints (standing) to review progress, blockers, and risks.
- Success criteria (initial) — quant baseline, quality gates, integration checklist, and procurement milestones.
- Single source MAP doc attached (SaaSCo_MAP_Template.xlsx) and a short Redwood POC checklist (redwood-POC-checklist.pdf).

Please confirm primary stakeholders on your side (security, infra, procurement) and whether Wed or Tue mornings PT work for a recurring slot.

First asks / next steps:
- You: confirm stakeholder list + preferred weekly slot
- Redwood: we’ll share an agenda and a filled MAP draft ahead of the first sync
- Karthik: provide estimated perf baseline template (cc’d)

Attachment: SaaSCo_MAP_Template.xlsx (MAP template), redwood-POC-checklist.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

Hannah —

Thanks for the outline and the attachments. Wednesday mornings tend to be better for our team; can we take Wednesdays at 10:00 AM PT as the standing slot? I’ll confirm the full attendee list but expect our security lead (cc’d as security@saasco.com) and Tom (procurement) to join.

A couple of items from our side we’d like to track in the MAP and get earlier visibility on:
- SOC 2 evidence and encryption/KMS details
- Network diagram and IP allowlist needs for the POC
- Expected SSO / auth flows for test users

We’ll upload the network diagram and our procurement form to the shared Drive after this note. Please include procurement contact Tom on future communications (he’s cc’d on this thread).

Thanks — Rebecca
